summary: An unreadable backup repository credential marks only that repository offline and can be replaced by registering the same repository again.

guide.reason: Operators get the recovery steps for a repository whose credential cannot be read.

api.reason: POST /api/v1/pools/{id}/backup-repositories and the Core registration call accept a same-ID credential replacement only when the old credential is unreadable; no new field or endpoint.

roadmap.reason: Bug fix; no milestone or acceptance gate changes.

state.record: pool-backup-repositories.json and the sealed backup credential receipts on the pool master.
state.reason: The repository record and credential reference stay on the master's Core; a fresh Controller re-adopts them through the existing backup repository inventory and now sees the offline health reason.

verification.method: Focused Go test in internal/agent with a stubbed systemd-creds and an in-process S3 fake; no lab run.
